pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with rounded vertices and diffuse edge gradients. Patches are roughly uniform in size across the flank with slightly reduced area on the lower extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pixels forming a topological grid. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate with consistent corridor width throughout the visible frame.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two dark avian silhouettes (oxpeckers) perched directly upon the dorsal ridge at the base of the neck and shoulder region.
